title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - QualityProperty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/QualityProperty. Class to group those properties related to the quality of power lines. Subclass of saref:Property (core SAREF). Same general/specific-via-SKOS pattern as EnergyAndPowerProperty, scoped to power-quality properties.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'QualityProperty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

propertyType.description: Property. The specific kind of power-quality property this instance represents, drawn from the SAREF4GRID controlled vocabulary of named QualityProperty individuals.

broaderPropertyType.description: Property (skos:broader). When this instance represents a specific, narrower, OBIS-identified property, this names the general QualityProperty individual it specializes.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code identifying this power-quality property instance.

unitOfMeasure.description: Property. Unit of measure of the property's values, where defined.
